lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: This is the Missilis Research Team.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We're picking up a signal from Volt-JU052,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: the robot you failed to capture before.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: According to the signal, it's in a desert.
A desert?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It must have determined the north to be too dangerous,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: so it decided to go elsewhere.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: These are all decisions made on its own.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We're quite astonished by what this technology is capable of.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: There have been countless attempts to create robotic animals as replacements,

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: but never have we seen success on this scale.
What do you mean by "replacement"?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Allow me to explain.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We're living in a new era, where humanoids, Nikkes, are now a reality.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Are animals not entitled to

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: a second lease on life as well?

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: By doing this, we'll be able to bring back

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: an aspect of our culture that has all but vanished; companionship between man and animal.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: It'll also help us solve some of the issues inherent in Nikke production.
What issues?
I haven't received any messages in a little while.
But...

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Look, I realize this is a lot. At least, it's enough to make your head spin.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: However, let's get back to the issue at hand.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: This is a one-of-a-kind creation, possessing unparalleled cutting-edge technology.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We must either get it back, or destroy it.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: Suppose you fail to catch Volt Jr. once more.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: In that case, we will assume it indicates you are either unwilling

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: or unable to carry out the assignment.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: We will then be forced to entrust the task to someone else.

lines.speaker: missilysresearch
lines.text: However, we hope it will not have to come to that.
It won't.
